scenes.title_cn: 修图16年：差距不在滤镜，在骨相
scenes.title_en: 16 Years Retouching: It's Structure, Not Filters
scenes.context: 作者修图十六年，圈子里把照片修得高级的人，靠的不是滤镜参数，而是对人像骨相的理解。液化就是给脸『重做骨相』。
sentences: 修图十六年，说点圈子里的大实话。
After sixteen years of retouching, let me tell you the truth the industry won't.
retouching（修图）
高级的照片，靠的不是滤镜。
High-end portraits don't come from filters.
filter（滤镜）
液化，就是给脸重做骨相。
Liquify is rebuilding the bone structure of the face.
rebuild（重建）
paraphrase: Here's the secret nobody in the industry talks about.
「参数易得，骨相难学」换种说法
Anyone can copy settings; few can read a face.
scenes.speak: After sixteen years of retouching, let me tell you the truth the industry won't. High-end portraits don't come from filters. Liquify is rebuilding the bone structure of the face.

scenes.title_cn: 骨相液化三区：脸型、五官、皮肉贴合
scenes.title_en: Three Zones: Face Shape, Features, and Skin-Bone Fit
scenes.context: 骨相液化的三个重点区域：脸型轮廓（下颌角与颧骨）、五官位置（眼鼻唇的间距）、皮肉贴合度（多余的肉感是否像挂在骨头上）。
sentences: 第一区，脸型轮廓：下颌角、颧骨。
Zone one, the face silhouette: jaw angle and cheekbones.
silhouette（轮廓）
第二区，五官的位置与间距。
Zone two, the placement and spacing of the features.
spacing（间距）
第三区，皮肉是否贴合骨骼。
Zone three, how well the flesh sits on the bone.
flesh sits on the bone（皮肉贴合）
paraphrase: Work the shape, then the features, then the fit.
Extra softness should drape, not sag, off the bone.
scenes.speak: Zone one, the face silhouette: jaw angle and cheekbones. Zone two, the placement and spacing of the features. Zone three, how well the flesh sits on the bone.

scenes.title_cn: 克制法则：动得越少越自然
scenes.title_en: The Law of Restraint: Less Is More Natural
scenes.context: 液化最大的风险是用力过猛。骨相调整的原则是『动得越少越自然』，宁可留一点不完美，也不要修出塑料感。
sentences: 液化最大的风险，是用力过猛。
The biggest risk in liquify is overdoing it.
overdo（用力过猛）
动得越少，越自然。
The less you move, the more natural it looks.
natural（自然的）
留一点不完美，比塑料感强。
Keeping a little imperfection beats looking plastic.
plastic look（塑料感）
paraphrase: A small move reads as real; a big one reads as fake.
scenes.speak: The biggest risk in liquify is overdoing it. The less you move, the more natural it looks. Keeping a little imperfection beats looking plastic.

practice: High-end portraits come from the bone structure.
Liquify works in three zones: shape, features, fit.
「动得越少越自然」用英文怎么说？
The less you move, the more natural it looks.
pitfalls: Copy filters and call it retouching.
Understand bone structure first, then apply tools.
Filters are fast; structure is what makes a portrait high-end.
Liquify every feature to a template.
Adjust only what breaks the silhouette and fit.
Templated faces lose the identity that makes them attractive.
Push the chin so small it turns into a point.
Respect the jaw's natural role in the profile.
Check the whole face between every fix.
Local perfection can destroy whole-face harmony.
